newsitem.title: UK: Two hurt in London letter bomb blast.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt in London letter bomb blast.

text.p: Two people were injured on Monday when a suspected letter bomb exploded in a London office building housing an Arab newspaper, police said.
The device exploded in the basement of the building in the Hammersmith area of west London.
One of the people injured in the blast received face and abdominal injuries while the second was less seriously injured, ambulance service officials said.
The offices house the Al Hayat newspaper publishing company and a number of other businesses.
A police source said: "Unconfirmed reports suggest that it is a letter bomb device."
Bomb experts from the police anti-terrorist squad, along with ambulance services and firefighters, were at the scene.
An ambulance service spokesman said: "There are two casualties, one with injuries to the face and abdomen and another with minor injuries."
Police said the building was evacuated and surrounding streets were cordoned off.
